info.name: Red Power Garage API
info.description:
Complete collection for the Red Power Garage API.

Base URL is stored in the `baseUrl` variable (defaults to http://localhost:3000/api/v1). Set ALLOWED_ORIGINS / CORS accordingly before calling from Postman.

## Authentication
Run `POST /auth/login` first; its test script stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` collection variables. The collection applies `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` automatically except on public routes. `POST /auth/refresh` uses the `refreshToken` variable.

## Response envelope
All success responses use:
```json
{ "statusCode": 200, "message": "translated message", "data": {} }
```
All error responses use:
```json
{ "statusCode": 400, "message": "translated message", "error": { "code": "validation.invalid_input", "details": [] }, "timestamp": "...", "path": "/api/v1/..." }
```
Messages are localized via the `Accept-Language` header (`en` or `ar`, default `en`).

## Status codes used by this API
- 200 OK: successful read / update / delete / login
- 201 Created: POST create endpoints
- 400 Bad Request: validation.invalid_input (whitelist rejects unknown fields)
- 401 Unauthorized: auth.errors.unauthorized (missing/expired token, bad login)
- 403 Forbidden: common.errors.forbidden (role not allowed)
- 404 Not Found: common.errors.not_found / database.errors.record_not_found
- 409 Conflict: database.errors.unique_constraint (duplicate plate/VIN/email)
- 429 Too Many Requests: throttle (login 5/min, refresh 10/min, logout 20/min)
- 500 Internal Server Error: system.errors.internal_server_error

## Path variables
Placeholder variables: `id`, `cardId`, `photoId`, `workId`, `kind`; replace their values with real UUIDs (or constants for `kind`) before running a request.

request.description:
Confirms the API is running. Public route, no authentication.

Success:
- 200 OK (statusCode 200, message from system.responses.api_running)

Errors:
- 500 if the server is unhealthy

Authenticates an active staff account and returns access/refresh tokens. Public route (rate limited: 5 per minute).

The test script stores `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into collection variables for all other requests.

Body (LoginDto):
- email: valid email, required
- password: min 8 chars, must contain upper + lower case and a digit or symbol

Success:
- 200 OK with data: { accessToken, refreshToken, user: { id, email, firstName, lastName, role, createdAt, updatedAt } }

Errors:
- 400 validation.invalid_input
- 401 auth.errors.unauthorized (wrong email/password, inactive account)
- 429 common.errors.too_many_requests

Rotates the refresh token and returns a fresh access/refresh pair. Requires a valid refresh JWT in `Authorization: Bearer` (uses the {{refreshToken}} variable). Rate limited: 10 per minute.

Success:
- 200 OK with data: { accessToken, refreshToken, user }

Errors:
- 401 auth.errors.unauthorized (missing/invalid refresh token, revoked session)
- 429 common.errors.too_many_requests

Revokes the stored refresh session for the authenticated staff account, then returns null data. Requires a valid access JWT (collection-level bearer). Rate limited: 20 per minute.

Success:
- 200 OK, data: null

Errors:
- 401 auth.errors.unauthorized
- 429 common.errors.too_many_requests

request.description:
Creates an OPEN maintenance card with its initial status event. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.

Body (CreateMaintenanceCardDto):
- customerId: UUID, required
- vehicleOwnershipId: UUID, required (active ownership record)
- receivedAt: ISO date-time, required
- expectedDeliveryAt: optional ISO date-time
- mileage: int >= 0
- fuelLevel: EMPTY | QUARTER | HALF | THREE_QUARTERS | FULL
- customerApproved: boolean, required
- customerApprovalName: optional (required if approved)
- customerApprovedAt: optional ISO date-time
- customerComplaint / inspectionNotes: optional
- visitReasonIds, vehicleConditionOptionIds, vehicleItemOptionIds: optional UUID arrays (must match active option's kind)
- requiredWorks: optional array of { description, displayOrder, isRequired?, estimatedCost? }

Success:
- 201 Created

Errors:
- 400 validation.invalid_input
- 401 auth.errors.unauthorized
- 403 common.errors.forbidden
- 404 if customer/ownership/option not found
- 409 for conflicting state

Lists/filters cards by number, status, customer, vehicle and received date. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.

Query (MaintenanceCardListQueryDto):
- page, limit
- search: max 100 chars
- status: OPEN | CLOSED
- customerId / vehicleId: optional UUIDs
- receivedFrom / receivedTo: ISO date-time, inclusive

Success:
- 200 OK, paginated cards

Errors:
- 400 validation.invalid_input
- 401 auth.errors.unauthorized
- 403 common.errors.forbidden

Returns complete maintenance-card details including works, selections, media and status events. Roles: ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN.

Success:

Errors:

Errors:

- 403 common.errors.forbidden

- 409 if card is CLOSED

Errors:

- 409 if card is CLOSED
